I can't pretend the policy says something different. Under our current policy, a late Standard parcel receives a 25% credit of the shipping fee, not 100%. Late Express parcels receive a 100% credit. The credit goes to your account within 7 days and is never paid out in cash. Delays caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address supplied by the customer are not eligible.

If you'd like, I can check the status of any of your shipments, such as NW1002, NW1003 or NW1004.
